svg.title: Clients by recency and frequency + spend
svg.desc: Champions: 237 clients (28%), 62% of revenue. New & promising: 99 clients (12%), 4% of revenue. Need attention: 167 clients (20%), 13% of revenue. At risk: 82 clients (10%), 15% of revenue. Lost: 255 clients (30%), 6% of revenue. Illustrative data from an independent hair salon.
